scope: Repeat NACA 0012 numerical-independence evidence affected by the corrected NASA TMR SSTm production equations

baseline.transport: exact Sutherland viscosity and molecular Prandtl 0.72

finest_pair_grid.initialization: restart from the previously converged source-mapped 449x129 fields, changing transport and SSTm production mapping before execution

scheme.candidate: LUST blended velocity and energy convection with unchanged turbulence upwind treatment
scheme.initialization: same-grid restart from the corrected 897x257 baseline
scheme.relaxation: Use the previously established stable LUST setting: one-half of the linear-upwind relaxation factors (p 0.1, rho 0.005, U/e 0.05, k/omega 0.15).

domain.candidate: exact retained structured row near 100 chords upstream and crossflow, retaining approximately 500-chord wake extent
domain.initialization: mapped or regenerated only through a separately audited restart
domain.relaxation: Use the prior reduced-domain half-relaxation setting (p 0.1, rho 0.005, U/e 0.05, k/omega 0.15).

common_required_gates: all solved-field final and final-window residual limits

decision_rule.independent_results: A failure in one check is preserved and is not hidden by passes in other checks.
decision_rule.benchmark_acceptance: Numerical refresh passing does not accept benchmark agreement; external force agreement must independently pass the predeclared uncertainty rule.
decision_rule.failure_handling: Preserve failed cases and coefficients; do not use coefficients from candidates that fail common gates.
